messages:
Elena Martin: Quick heads-up — changewindow opens 22:00 UTC. Final gating: any freeze exemptions we need to declare?
Jamal Khan: Telemetry patch (non-user-facing) — request exemption. 1-file change, no schema.
Riley Chu: Recommending we pin inference-runtime to v2.3.1 for this rollout. Performance reasons.
deploy-bot: Scheduled change window: 2026-05-18 22:00 UTC -> 23:30 UTC. Canary policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-rollback threshold: 5% elevated error rate for 10m.
Elena Martin: noted on pin. Jamal, please paste the PR link and an owner for post-deploy watch.
Jamal Khan: PR: https://repo.redwood.ai/r/redwood/telemetry/pull/482 — owner @Jamal. Non-blocking but prefer exemption so no pin required.
Sasha Iyer: Ops ok with exemption only if we add a quick healthcheck to the rollout and confirm no KV schema changes. Can you add a readiness probe?
Jamal Khan: added readiness probe and smoke test. snippet:
```
curl -sS http://health.internal/telemetry | grep OK
```
Sasha Iyer: perfect. ops approves exemption contingent on smoke passing during canary.
Maya (product-ops): we need release notes published by 21:30 UTC — I'll draft a short note, please review.
Riley Chu: also calling out model pin for the hosted route: model-id: redwood/llama-compat@2026-05-10. That prevents unexpected weights change.
Elena Martin: Rollback plan: manual rollback command + deploy-bot auto-rollback. Manual command for eng oncall:
```
./scripts/rollback.sh --service inference --to-version v2.3.0 
```
Elena Martin: oncall-bot, please post incident channel alert if rollback triggers.
oncall-bot: Will post to #incidents and page the oncall rotation if auto-rollback executes.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks complete: infra quotas ok, dedicated pool available, canary image built. Trigger when you give :thumbsup:.
Riley Chu: +1 from runtime.
Sasha Iyer: +1 from ops, will monitor logs and latency dashboards.
Jamal Khan: +1 from telemetry owner. Smoke tests green in staging.
Elena Martin: final checklist for launch quiet window:
- pin runtime and model (Riley)
- publish release notes (Maya)
- exemption documented in changelog (Jamal/Sasha)
- rollback command validated (Elena)
- oncall/watch rota covered (Sasha)

Elena Martin: If no objections by 21:45 UTC, we consider exemption granted and proceed with canary at 22:00 UTC.
Maya (product-ops): I'll drop the release notes in #release-notes and tag the PMs.
Sasha Iyer: tagging @oncall to confirm monitoring coverage.
Elena Martin: thanks everyone — I'll kick the deploy at 22:00 unless someone raises a last-minute hold. :sparkles:
